purpose: Per-source_class ingestion maturity. Honest ladder of how far each connector has gone from 'no folder' to 'anti-bypass proven'. A connector may NOT claim a rung it cannot prove: a maturity level above m6_proof requires a proof script that exists; api/csv/json/webhook are M8 (proven by check_multi_source_ingestion); pdf/html are candidate (parser is a cataloged candidate → explicit non-consumable, never faked); markdown_folder/local_folder_batch are at m4 (lane B is building the impl this batch — main agent bumps after its proof lands); obsidian_vault/customer_database are candidate (fixture-contract only).

maturity_model.m4_local_fixture_or_stub_exists: a deterministic local fixture or stub adapter exists; contract is exercisable
maturity_model.m5_integrated: wired into the registry + sync planner + artifact store path
maturity_model.m6_proof: a registered proof exercises the connector end-to-end
maturity_model.m7_api: reachable via an ingest API/CLI route
maturity_model.m8_ui: proven by an end-to-end multi-source ingestion proof (current top rung for active connectors)
maturity_model.m9_antibypass: anti-bypass enforced (no connector writes served facts; tenant_private never updates global_public; idempotency enforced)
maturity_model.candidate: real parser/driver is a cataloged candidate; stores raw NON-consumable, never fakes truth

source_classes.note: the proven beachhead; structured fields → promotion-eligible facts, free-text → held-out allegations

known_gaps: duplicate-delivery idempotency receipt path is contract-defined; end-to-end push proof sequenced next
real cleaner is the scraping_manager slot (crawl4ai/scrapy) — candidate; UnavailableParserAdapter stores raw NON-consumable, never fakes a parse
real extractor is the parser_manager slot (Docling/Unstructured) — candidate; raw stored NON-consumable, never faked
lane B is building the markdown adapter + its proof this batch; main agent bumps to m6+ after it lands
lane B is building the folder-batch adapter + its proof this batch; main agent bumps after it lands
note-link graph is LINEAGE only, never served truth; replacement repos (boxpositron/markdown-vault, benmaster82/Kwipu) are catalogued candidates behind the port — never pip-installed/executed
real DB driver is a future adapter behind the port; tenant_private ONLY — a customer DB never updates global_public; CDC watermark contract defined, end-to-end proof sequenced next
